Breathes fire towards the target location, dealing 300% of attack damage as physical damage to enemies along the path, triggering an attack modifier once, causing a slight knockback stun, and slowing movement speed by 25% for 4 seconds.

dragon_knight_001.descPlain: Breathes fire towards the target location, dealing 300% of attack damage as physical damage to enemies along the path, triggering an attack modifier once, causing a slight knockback stun, and slowing movement speed by 25% for 4 seconds.
dragon_knight_001.name: Breathe Fire

desc.v: After channeling for 0.5 seconds, sweeps a 90-degree cone with a 350 radius in front, dealing 400% of attack damage as physical damage.

dragon_knight_002.descPlain: After channeling for 0.5 seconds, sweeps a 90-degree cone with a 350 radius in front, dealing 400% of attack damage as physical damage.
dragon_knight_002.name: Dragon Tail

desc.v: Consumes 30% of current health. The enchantment lasts for 7 seconds, causing attacks to deal an additional 45% of attack damage as magic damage. Bonus damage increases by 1% with each consecutive attack on the same target, resetting upon switching targets. Dragon Form: Fire increases damage by 6% per stack and resets if the time between attacks exceeds 4 seconds; Frost reduces movement and attack speed by 1% per stack; Poison applies 1 stack of poison per attack.

dragon_knight_003.descPlain: Consumes 30% of current health. The enchantment lasts for 7 seconds, causing attacks to deal an additional 45% of attack damage as magic damage. Bonus damage increases by 1% with each consecutive attack on the same target, resetting upon switching targets. Dragon Form: Fire increases damage by 6% per stack and resets if the time between attacks exceeds 4 seconds; Frost reduces movement and attack speed by 1% per stack; Poison applies 1 stack of poison per attack.
dragon_knight_003.name: Enchanted Blade

desc.v: Lasts for 7 seconds: Movement speed is reduced by 60%, armor and health regen are doubled. Each attack received grants an additional 5 armor and 20 health regen until the effect ends.

dragon_knight_004.descPlain: Lasts for 7 seconds: Movement speed is reduced by 60%, armor and health regen are doubled. Each attack received grants an additional 5 armor and 20 health regen until the effect ends.
dragon_knight_004.name: Dragon's Majesty

desc.v: Gains a base max shield cap equal to 10% of max health, and replenishes an equal amount of shield when the ability is acquired.

Whenever taking damage, immediately restores the shield by 30% of the actual health lost, including damage from negative statuses and health costs; this restoration will not exceed the current max shield cap, nor will it increase it.

dragon_knight_005.descPlain:
Gains a base max shield cap equal to 10% of max health, and replenishes an equal amount of shield when the ability is acquired.
Whenever taking damage, immediately restores the shield by 30% of the actual health lost, including damage from negative statuses and health costs; this restoration will not exceed the current max shield cap, nor will it increase it.
dragon_knight_005.name: Dragon's Roar

desc.v: For every 10% max health lost, gains 5% attack speed and movement speed.

dragon_knight_006.descPlain: For every 10% max health lost, gains 5% attack speed and movement speed.
dragon_knight_006.name: Dragon's Wrath

desc.v: Transforms into the dragon corresponding to your innate passive for 20 seconds, resetting the cooldowns and charges of Q/W/E/D/F and restoring 35% of maximum health. Fire Dragon: +30% Health, +10% Armor, +10% Shield Limit, attacks gain 45% physical cleave; Frost Dragon: +30% Attack Damage, +10% Attack and Movement Speed, attacks apply a 1% dual slow that stacks up to 20 times and lasts 5 seconds; Poison Dragon: +7.5% Critical Chance, +50% Critical Damage, +20% Bonus Damage, attacks apply 1 stack of poison and deal 10% more damage to poisoned targets.

dragon_knight_007.descPlain: Transforms into the dragon corresponding to your innate passive for 20 seconds, resetting the cooldowns and charges of Q/W/E/D/F and restoring 35% of maximum health. Fire Dragon: +30% Health, +10% Armor, +10% Shield Limit, attacks gain 45% physical cleave; Frost Dragon: +30% Attack Damage, +10% Attack and Movement Speed, attacks apply a 1% dual slow that stacks up to 20 times and lasts 5 seconds; Poison Dragon: +7.5% Critical Chance, +50% Critical Damage, +20% Bonus Damage, attacks apply 1 stack of poison and deal 10% more damage to poisoned targets.
dragon_knight_007.name: Dragon Form

desc.v: Charges towards the target location up to a maximum distance of 500, restoring 5% of maximum health. (The source of stacks for the three dragon powers is yet to be determined; stack enhancements are disabled in the initial version.)

dragon_knight_008.descPlain: Charges towards the target location up to a maximum distance of 500, restoring 5% of maximum health. (The source of stacks for the three dragon powers is yet to be determined; stack enhancements are disabled in the initial version.)
dragon_knight_008.name: Dragon Charge

desc.v: When a basic attack (including each hit of Breathe Fire) deals damage, it deals an additional 4% of max health as magic damage.

c.v: Equipping this sets your dragon type to Fire Dragon: Elder Dragon Form and the dragon form effects of all abilities will function as the Fire Dragon version.

dragon_knight_009.descPlain:
When a basic attack (including each hit of Breathe Fire) deals damage, it deals an additional 4% of max health as magic damage.
Equipping this sets your dragon type to Fire Dragon: Elder Dragon Form and the dragon form effects of all abilities will function as the Fire Dragon version.
dragon_knight_009.name: Red Dragon's Might

desc.v: For every 1 point of movement speed the target loses due to a slow, your damage dealt to them is increased by 1%.

c.v: Equipping this sets your dragon type to Ice Dragon: Elder Dragon Form and the dragon form effects of all abilities will function as the Ice Dragon version.

dragon_knight_010.descPlain:
For every 1 point of movement speed the target loses due to a slow, your damage dealt to them is increased by 1%.
Equipping this sets your dragon type to Ice Dragon: Elder Dragon Form and the dragon form effects of all abilities will function as the Ice Dragon version.
dragon_knight_010.name: Frost Dragon's Breath

desc.v: The number of poison stacks you apply is doubled; each stack of poison you apply deals an additional 5% of attack damage as magic damage per second. Stacks decay according to the universal poison rules.

c.v: Equipping this sets your dragon type to Poison Dragon: Elder Dragon Form and the dragon form effects of all abilities will function as the Poison Dragon version.

dragon_knight_011.descPlain:
The number of poison stacks you apply is doubled; each stack of poison you apply deals an additional 5% of attack damage as magic damage per second. Stacks decay according to the universal poison rules.
Equipping this sets your dragon type to Poison Dragon: Elder Dragon Form and the dragon form effects of all abilities will function as the Poison Dragon version.
dragon_knight_011.name: Poison Dragon's Fang

desc.v: Fires a piercing arrow forward, dealing physical damage equal to 500% of agility to enemies in its path and reducing armor by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times.

drow_002.descPlain: Fires a piercing arrow forward, dealing physical damage equal to 500% of agility to enemies in its path and reducing armor by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times.
drow_002.name: Ability 002

desc.v: Continuously fires 6 waves of arrows in the target direction. During this time, the caster can move with 40% reduced movement speed, but facing direction is locked and normal attacks are disabled. Each wave randomly fires 5-7 arrows at a 0.1s interval, with a 20% increased interval between waves, covering a 50-degree cone. Each arrow is destroyed upon hitting the first enemy, dealing physical damage equal to 2.6 times total attack damage and counting as an attack. An enemy can take damage from an arrow at most once per wave. Other abilities cannot be cast during the volley; only Backstep can interrupt it.

drow_005.descPlain: Continuously fires 6 waves of arrows in the target direction. During this time, the caster can move with 40% reduced movement speed, but facing direction is locked and normal attacks are disabled. Each wave randomly fires 5-7 arrows at a 0.1s interval, with a 20% increased interval between waves, covering a 50-degree cone. Each arrow is destroyed upon hitting the first enemy, dealing physical damage equal to 2.6 times total attack damage and counting as an attack. An enemy can take damage from an arrow at most once per wave. Other abilities cannot be cast during the volley; only Backstep can interrupt it.
drow_005.name: Ability 005

desc.v: After casting an ability, automatically targets the nearest enemy within a 1000 radius, detonating at their location after a 0.3-second delay. Deals magical damage equal to 200% of your attack damage + 0 to enemies within a 350 radius.

lina_008.descPlain: After casting an ability, automatically targets the nearest enemy within a 1000 radius, detonating at their location after a 0.3-second delay. Deals magical damage equal to 200% of your attack damage + 0 to enemies within a 350 radius.
lina_008.name: Skill 008

desc.v: Releases a Burning Thunder at the target enemy, dealing 700% of your intelligence as magic damage, then bounces to the nearest unhit enemy within 450 range. Can bounce up to 4 times. Each enemy can only be hit once. For every 100 intelligence, Burning Thunder's damage is increased by 10%, up to a maximum of 300%.

lina_014.descPlain: Releases a Burning Thunder at the target enemy, dealing 700% of your intelligence as magic damage, then bounces to the nearest unhit enemy within 450 range. Can bounce up to 4 times. Each enemy can only be hit once. For every 100 intelligence, Burning Thunder's damage is increased by 10%, up to a maximum of 300%.
lina_014.name: Burning Thunder

desc.v: Throws a large boomerang at the target location that automatically returns to you. Deals 400% of attack damage as physical damage to enemies along its path both on the way out and back. Each enemy can only take damage once per travel direction. Flies up to a distance of 900. The boomerang cannot pass through walls: if it hits a wall on the way out, it stops in front of it; if blocked on the way back, it disappears, and it cannot hit enemies behind walls.

pa_013.descPlain: Throws a large boomerang at the target location that automatically returns to you. Deals 400% of attack damage as physical damage to enemies along its path both on the way out and back. Each enemy can only take damage once per travel direction. Flies up to a distance of 900. The boomerang cannot pass through walls: if it hits a wall on the way out, it stops in front of it; if blocked on the way back, it disappears, and it cannot hit enemies behind walls.
pa_013.name: Boomerang

desc.v: Teleport to the shade's current position. Available while the shade is dashing; costs no mana.

void_spirit_001_step.descPlain: Teleport to the shade's current position. Available while the shade is dashing; costs no mana.
void_spirit_001_step.name: Shade Step

desc.v: Pulls nearby enemies, briefly stunning them and dealing physical damage equal to 80% of Axe's max health plus max shield. Grants 30% armor and 15 flat armor for 6 seconds.

axe_005.descPlain: Pulls nearby enemies, briefly stunning them and dealing physical damage equal to 80% of Axe's max health plus max shield. Grants 30% armor and 15 flat armor for 6 seconds.
axe_005.name: Challenge Roar

desc.v: Consumes 30% of current health. Gains Debuff Immunity for 20 seconds and enters a rage: Max Health and Armor +35%, incoming damage reduced by 10%. Also applies 5 stacks of Vulnerability to enemies within a 800 radius for 20 seconds.

axe_006.descPlain: Consumes 30% of current health. Gains Debuff Immunity for 20 seconds and enters a rage: Max Health and Armor +35%, incoming damage reduced by 10%. Also applies 5 stacks of Vulnerability to enemies within a 800 radius for 20 seconds.
axe_006.name: Berserk Fury

desc.v: Attacks have a 35% chance to restore 3% of max health and shield, and apply 1 stack of Vulnerability. This effect has a cooldown.

axe_012.descPlain: Attacks have a 35% chance to restore 3% of max health and shield, and apply 1 stack of Vulnerability. This effect has a cooldown.
axe_012.name: Berserker's Suppression

desc.v: Erupts after a 1-second delay, dealing distance-scaled magical damage to enemies within a 400 radius. Deals (15 + 640% of Agility) × 150% damage within 128 units of the center, falling linearly to 100% at the edge. Targets within 128 units are stunned for 0.5 seconds. All enemies hit receive 1 stacks of Freeze. The impact delay is affected by attack speed.

drow_001.descPlain: Erupts after a 1-second delay, dealing distance-scaled magical damage to enemies within a 400 radius. Deals (15 + 640% of Agility) × 150% damage within 128 units of the center, falling linearly to 100% at the edge. Targets within 128 units are stunned for 0.5 seconds. All enemies hit receive 1 stacks of Freeze. The impact delay is affected by attack speed.
drow_001.name: Frost Star Shot

desc.v: Shoots an arrow at a nearby enemy every 1 seconds; this is treated as a normal attack. For attack speed above 200, every 100 attack speed increases the shooting frequency by 50%. Click to toggle on/off; on by default.

drow_008.descPlain: Shoots an arrow at a nearby enemy every 1 seconds; this is treated as a normal attack. For attack speed above 200, every 100 attack speed increases the shooting frequency by 50%. Click to toggle on/off; on by default.
drow_008.name: Frost Volley

desc.v: Summons a shade that dashes in the target direction, dealing 380% of your Intelligence as magical damage to enemies it crashes through and stunning them for 0.5 seconds; the shade pierces enemies without vanishing. While the shade is dashing, this ability is replaced by Shade Step: teleport to the shade's current position.

void_spirit_001.descPlain: Summons a shade that dashes in the target direction, dealing 380% of your Intelligence as magical damage to enemies it crashes through and stunning them for 0.5 seconds; the shade pierces enemies without vanishing. While the shade is dashing, this ability is replaced by Shade Step: teleport to the shade's current position.
void_spirit_001.name: Aether Remnant

desc.v: Dashes up to 512 distance in the target direction. Enemies struck along the path take 100% of your Intelligence as magical damage and receive an Astral Mark. The mark detonates after 1.5 seconds, dealing 200% of your Intelligence as magical damage. Applying a mark to an already marked target detonates it immediately.

void_spirit_004.descPlain: Dashes up to 512 distance in the target direction. Enemies struck along the path take 100% of your Intelligence as magical damage and receive an Astral Mark. The mark detonates after 1.5 seconds, dealing 200% of your Intelligence as magical damage. Applying a mark to an already marked target detonates it immediately.
void_spirit_004.name: Astral Step

npc_dota_hero_axe.desc: I rely on strength and resilience to stand where the danger is greatest. Choose me to endure damage, draw enemy attention, and control the battlefield with counterattacks.
npc_dota_hero_axe.name: Axe

npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.desc: Try Dragon Knight in Season 3: Breathe Fire, Enchanted Blade, Dragon's Roar, Dragon Charge, and Dragon Form. Defaults to Red Dragon's Might. After official class transfer, you can choose Frost Dragon or Poison Dragon builds in the ability bar. The initial version has not yet integrated exclusive talents and Dragon Power stack enhancements.
npc_dota_hero_dragon_knight.name: Dragon Knight

npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.desc: I suppress enemies with precise archery and biting frost. Choose me for safe ranged damage, freezing control, and agile repositioning, but you must maintain distance and time your shots.
npc_dota_hero_drow_ranger.name: Drow Ranger

npc_dota_hero_lina.desc: I turn flame and magic into devastating bursts. Choose me for powerful area damage and wave clearing, but mind your positioning and spell rhythm.
npc_dota_hero_lina.name: Lina

npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.desc: I exploit enemy weaknesses with agility and burst damage. Choose me for nimble movement and high single-target damage, but you must know when to advance and retreat.
npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin.name: Phantom Assassin

npc_dota_hero_void_spirit.desc: I move between reality and the void, controlling the battlefield with remnants, dissimilation, and resonant power. Choose me for agile movement, area burst, and shielding, but you must time every engagement and retreat carefully.
npc_dota_hero_void_spirit.name: Void Spirit
